\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[ybar=2pt,bar width=5mm,scale only axis,width=60mm,height=40mm,
    xmin=0,xmax=4,ymin=0,ymax=8,enlargelimits=false,
    axis lines=box,xtick=\empty,ytick=\empty]
    \addplot[draw=blue,fill=blue!25!white,error bars/.cd,y dir=both,y explicit]
        table[x=trial,y=mean,y error plus=hi,y error minus=lo] {
            trial mean hi lo
            1     3    1  .5
            3     5    .75 1.25
        };
    \addplot[draw=red,fill=red!25!white,error bars/.cd,y dir=both,y explicit]
        table[x=trial,y=mean,y error plus=hi,y error minus=lo] {
            trial mean hi lo
            1     5    .5 1.25
            3     3.5  1.25 .75
        };
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
